supplementary_dependency_source_review: The Phase 3 verifier inspected parent-supplied version-labeled torrent@v1.61.0 and dht/v2@v2.23.0 source extracts. go.mod/go.sum record the expected versions and checksums. The verifier reports torrent source matching a local upstream extraction, but the original DHT module zip was absent and its h1 could not be independently recalculated. Source semantics suggest outbound get_peers may carry the magnet infohash before private metadata is known; no PacketConn write was observed, so this remains needs_validation. External dependency paths are intentionally excluded from findings trace/evidence.
non_finding_hardening: Benchmark scripts accept manually supplied executable/output paths and use writable host scratch plus uncapped logs, but the declared practice uses hash-recorded test binaries built from the frozen repo and no product user selects them. This remains operator-side storage hardening, not a confirmed security finding.
